sloka: महा अचल निभैः घोरैः पनसो नाम यूथपः ।आजगाम महावीर्यः तिसृभिः कोटिभिः वृतः ॥४-३९-२१॥
transliteration: mahā acala nibhaiḥ ghoraiḥ panaso nāma yūthapaḥ ।ājagāma mahāvīryaḥ tisṛbhiḥ koṭibhiḥ vṛtaḥ ॥4-39-21॥

translations.english: Similarly, the great warrior named Panasa, leader of the troop, reported with three crore dreadful vanaras of the size of huge mountains.
